target.definition: Total U.S. retail and food services sales for June 2026, seasonally adjusted, as first reported in the Census Bureau's advance estimate, in US dollars.

inputs.name: annual_retail_sales_2025
inputs.description: Total U.S. retail and food services sales for calendar year 2025, seasonally adjusted, in USD

provenance.rationale: 2024 sales were about $7.1T; ~3-4% nominal growth gives ~$7.35T for 2025

inputs.name: monthly_share_of_year
inputs.description: Fraction of annual sales occurring in an average month (1/12)

provenance.rationale: Monthly sales are roughly 1/12 of annual total

inputs.name: june_seasonal_factor
inputs.description: Ratio of June seasonally adjusted sales to an average month

provenance.rationale: Seasonal adjustment removes month effects, so June is near average

inputs.name: yoy_growth_factor_2026
inputs.description: Nominal year-over-year growth factor from mid-2025 to mid-2026

provenance.rationale: Recent nominal retail sales growth has run ~3-4% per year

inputs.name: monthly_sales_per_capita
inputs.description: Average monthly retail and food services sales per U.S. resident

provenance.rationale: Annual per-capita retail sales ~$21-22k, divided by 12

inputs.name: june_2025_monthly_sales
inputs.description: Advance estimate of total retail and food services sales for June 2025, seasonally adjusted

provenance.rationale: Monthly sales in mid-2025 were roughly $720B

inputs.name: months_between
inputs.description: Number of months from June 2025 to June 2026

inputs.name: monthly_growth_factor
inputs.description: Average month-over-month nominal growth factor in retail sales

provenance.rationale: ~3.5% annual growth compounds to ~0.29% per month

paths.description: Annual 2025 sales allocated to June 2026 via monthly share, seasonal factor, and YoY growth
June 2025 advance sales grown forward by monthly growth factor over 12 months

problems: path p3: formula: exponent must be a plain number
